description: Ancestry-stratified frequencies of recurrent ATM pathogenic alleles to test for founder effects
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Ancestry-stratified frequencies for the recurrent / founder ATM alleles
VARS = {
 "11-108284280-AG-A":"c.3802del p.Val1268Ter (fs)",
 "11-108301698-C-T":"c.5228C>T p.Thr1743Ile (mis)",
 "11-108331884-CTCTAGAATT-C":"c.7638_7646del p.Arg2547_Ser2549del",
 "11-108329202-T-G":"c.7271T>G p.Val2424Gly (mis)",
 "11-108251025-CAG-C":"c.1564_1565del p.Glu522fs",
 "11-108335959-A-T":"c.8266A>T p.Lys2756Ter",
 "11-108304801-C-T":"c.5623C>T p.Arg1875Ter",
 "11-108353881-G-A":"c.8786+1G>A (splice)",
 "11-108250699-A-T":"c.1236-2A>T (splice)",
 "11-108343371-GGTGA-G":"c.8418+5_8418+8del",
}
QV = """
query($vid: String!, $ds: DatasetId!) {
  variant(variantId: $vid, dataset: $ds) {
    variant_id
    exome { ac an af populations { id ac an } }
  }
}
"""
POP = {"afr":"African/African American","amr":"Admixed American","asj":"Ashkenazi Jewish",
       "eas":"East Asian","fin":"Finnish","nfe":"Non-Finnish European","sas":"South Asian",
       "mid":"Middle Eastern","remaining":"Remaining"}
rows=[]
for vid,lab in VARS.items():
    d = requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",
        json={"query":QV,"variables":{"vid":vid,"ds":"gnomad_r4"}}, timeout=120).json()["data"]["variant"]
    ex = d["exome"]
    for p in ex["populations"]:
        pid = p["id"]
        if pid in POP and p["an"]>10000:
            rows.append({"variant":lab,"pop":POP[pid],"ac":p["ac"],"an":p["an"],
                         "af":p["ac"]/p["an"] if p["an"] else 0})
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
piv = df.pivot_table(index="variant", columns="pop", values="af")*1e5   # per 100,000 alleles
piv = piv[[c for c in ["African/African American","Admixed American","Ashkenazi Jewish","East Asian",
                       "Finnish","Middle Eastern","Non-Finnish European","South Asian"] if c in piv.columns]]
pd.set_option("display.width",250)
print("Allele frequency per 100,000 alleles, gnomAD v4 exomes:\n")
print(piv.round(1).to_string())

# Founder enrichment: max population AF / NFE AF
enr = (piv.max(axis=1)/piv["Non-Finnish European"]).sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nFold enrichment of top ancestry vs Non-Finnish European:")
for k,v in enr.items():
    top = piv.loc[k].idxmax()
    print(f"  {k:42s} {v:6.1f}x  in {top}")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11,5.5))
import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
d = piv.fillna(0)
im = ax.imshow(np.log10(d.values+0.5), cmap="YlOrRd", aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(d.shape[1])); ax.set_xticklabels(d.columns, rotation=35, ha="right", fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(d.shape[0])); ax.set_yticklabels(d.index, fontsize=9)
for i in range(d.shape[0]):
    for j in range(d.shape[1]):
        v = d.values[i,j]
        ax.text(j,i, "0" if v==0 else f"{v:.1f}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8,
                color="black" if v < 30 else "white")
ax.set_title("Recurrent ATM pathogenic alleles: frequency per 100,000 alleles by gnomAD v4 ancestry group\n"
             "(colour = log10 scale; founder enrichment visible in Ashkenazi Jewish and Finnish groups)", fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
